Name: Reversal Wave
Casting Time: 1 reaction, which you take in response to an attack hitting you
Description: In response to the triggering attack, you create a naginata-shaped energy construct that you use to deflect the attack. When you do, roll 2d10 × the level this spell is cast at, then reduce the damage you would take by that amount. If this number exceeds the damage and the attacker is within range, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the points that exceeded the damage as force damage on a failure. Sword Saint Bonus. When this spell is cast by a sword saint, it is treated as being cast one level higher. This spell is also treated as being on the class spell list(s) of any creature who has at least three levels in sword saint.
